title: How RB2B hit $1.9M ARR from cold email: infrastructure, three campaigns, 4-month testing
summary: Adam Robinson explains how cold email drives about a third of RB2B's $6M+ ARR. Most founders fail by ignoring infrastructure, emailing only truly cold lists, and quitting early. RB2B ran three strategies: waitlist launch emails, pure cold outbound, and AI-personalized retargeting of site visitors, which converted best.

principles.text: Build deliverability infrastructure before writing copy; a perfect message in spam is worthless.
principles.quote: Your perfect message means nothing if it lands in a spam folder.

principles.text: Warm your audience first. Post on LinkedIn for months before emailing so cold contacts already know you.
principles.quote: We spent 3 months posting on LinkedIn generating awareness of me and what we were going to do at RB2B before we sent a single email.

principles.text: Build a waitlist in public with a simple CTA, then email it on launch day as warm outreach.
principles.quote: Then by launch day, 3,000 people were already waiting to sign up for RB2B.

principles.text: Write short, punchy cold emails in your own voice, with the benefit in the first line and one clear call to action.
principles.quote: It's short, punchy copy. It captured my actual voice. It's not corporate speak or formal business language.

principles.text: Commit to a multi-month testing window; early results mislead and most founders quit too soon.
principles.quote: Most founders give up after sending only 500 emails. We committed to 4 months of testing to find message market fit.

principles.text: Retarget website visitors fast with simple, contextual email; timing at peak interest beats generic cold outreach.
principles.quote: Hey, saw you on our site via RB2. Do you have any questions?
